extraction.Name: Louis Richard
extraction.Recorded patent: Patent recorded Aug. 7, 1922 by Home Abstract Co., Martin, So. Lak.
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged NWA 12-36-36 to Federal Land Bank of Omaha, Nebr. for $1000.00, recorded 10-12-22; mortgaged NWA 12-36-36 (with other land) to Rancher's State Bank, Cody, Nebr. for $1110.69, recorded 6-3-26; mortgaged NWA 12-36-36 (with other land) to Rancher's State Bank, Cody, Nebr. for $2000.00, recorded Mar. 2, 1928; Rancher's State Bank, Cody, Nebr. released mortgage dated Mar. 1, 1928 on Oct. 13, 1928
extraction.NOTES: Louis F. Richard and Annie Richard, his wife, are named in all mortgage transactions. Receipt dated Jan. 15, 1920. Land described as NWA 12-36-36. Records taken from County Seat.
